answer: Trace matching across epochs. Each identity must keep low divergence between its current-epoch action vector and its own prior-epoch vector under a fixed feature schema; matches below threshold earn eligibility. Like a dune shifting slowly, an identity's vector may drift only within a fixed bound. A shared fable copied across accounts fails because divergence exceeds the bound. An attacker must pay for one separate endpoint and sustained unique interactions per identity across at least three epochs; a stale relic of a past profile cannot be reused because its trace no longer matches.
